activities.description: Shop Owner introduces the Space Shop, emphasizing a 'grand opening.' He's joined by the Muscular Brute.
The Shop Owner showcases a variety of weapons, including a double-barreled shotgun, an energy rifle, and a rocket launcher.
The Shop Owner presents a large, flaming axe. The Muscular Brute gets excited and throws it, launching himself into the air.
The Shop Owner introduces the Cyberpunk Woman, highlighting the shop's fashionable items. She shows off a new outfit.
The Shop Owner encourages viewers to visit the Space Shop, promising the best prices in the universe.

characterInteraction.description: The Shop Owner and his companions interact in an over-the-top, comedic manner. The Brute serves as a source of physical comedy, while the Cyberpunk Woman embodies a confident, sassy attitude.
